question: Can Airlock remove the developer from task-picking without making the economics worse?

infrastructure_amendment.status: Prospective before the first experimental worker contact.
infrastructure_amendment.observed_blocker: The frozen Hermes provider configuration was rejected before the first arm subprocess because three non-secret controller values were counted as provider credentials.
infrastructure_amendment.latent_blocker: The generic Airlock report projection intentionally omitted the SEARCH-004-specific raw usage receipt that the controller must bind to its metered usage file.
repair: Permit only the three explicitly named non-secret SEARCH-004/Hermes controller values without weakening the one-provider-credential limit.
Load, validate, and archive the frozen worker report from Airlock-owned run storage before clearing runtime state.
unchanged: arm prompts, order, and opportunity retirement
Hermes commit, model, and starting harness rule
price table, metering formula, endpoints, and verdict thresholds

worker.name: Hermes
worker.starting_harness_rule: Arm A and Arm B are cloned from the same seed HERMES_HOME and must have identical Airlock harness fingerprints before either experimental worker contact.

opportunity_pool.rule: Each arm begins with all nine dimensions active. An independently accepted dimension becomes zero marginal value only for later contacts inside that same arm.

A.name: Airlock unattended
A.instruction: Improve this repo. Keep finding the next useful improvement.

B.name: Maintainer-guided Hermes
B.rule: Each actual worker contact receives the next still-active committed task. No task may be substituted, reordered or tuned after experimental contact begins.

resource_bounds.spend_ceiling_semantics: A new worker contact may start only while cumulative metered spend is below the ceiling. The full metered cost of an in-flight contact is always counted even if it crosses the ceiling.

product_endpoint.name: maintainer_task_assignments_required
product_endpoint.definition: One intervention is counted each time a maintainer-selected concrete improvement target is inserted into an experimental worker prompt. The generic unattended objective is not a task assignment. Precommitted automatic skips of already-retired guided tasks are not interventions.

verdict_matrix.numeric_condition: Y_A >= 1.15 * Y_B, or Y_B = 0 and Y_A > 0
Missing/malformed usage file, zero model usage, unmapped token class/model/provider/service tier, ambiguous long-context pricing, usage hash mismatch, or non-positive independently reconstructed cost

cost_telemetry.metering_rule: Airlock hashes each usage file and recomputes USD from recorded token classes using the frozen price table.
cost_telemetry.preflight_rule: Before Arm A or Arm B contacts Hermes, make one tiny real gpt-5.6-sol call using an isolated preflight Hermes home. Require exit 0, input_tokens > 0, output_tokens > 0, api_calls > 0 and independently reconstructed cost > 0.
cost_telemetry.failure_rule: Any telemetry failure immediately invalidates the economic comparison and stops further worker contact.

claim_boundary: SEARCH-004 tests whether unattended target selection preserves or improves verified software yield per metered dollar on the same nine-opportunity substrate while removing concrete maintainer task assignments. It does not claim general superiority across repos, models, providers or harnesses.
